name: Pile-Up Poker

gif.alt: Making some hands in Pile-Up Poker

rules: You'll get 5 cards each round. Place 4 on the grid and discard one.
Try to form poker hands in every row, column and in the four corners.
Score all nine hands on the grid and your discard pile becomes a hand too.
scoring: Better hands earn more points. Corners pay double, your discards pay triple, and every extra hand you make pumps up your multiplier.
